newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Germany to open chamber of commerce in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Germany to open chamber of commerce in Morocco.

text.p: German Economy Minister Gunter Rexrodt will open the first German chamber of commerce and industry in Morocco's financial centre of Casablanca next week, a spokesman at the German embassy said on Wednesday.
"The new institution, which will gather businessmen from both countries, is expected to give an impetus to economic relations and trade exchange between Morocco and Germany," the spokesman said.
Despite the presence of more than 100 German firms in the kingdom, exchanges between the two countries were still below their real trade potential, he added.
Morocco's imports from Germany reached 4.2 billion dirhams ($456 million) against 1.3 billion dirhams ($141 million) exports in 1996, the official trade regulatory bureau said.
An estimated 160,000 German tourists visit Morocco every year, it said.
